title: Update Node.js via NVM
description: Installs current LTS Node.js versions (per the official release schedule), sets the latest as default, migrates global packages, and removes non-LTS versions.

versions.notes: Commands run in the background, and only missing or outdated global packages are reinstalled.
Errors show the command's own message instead of a generic exit status.
Renamed to "Update Node.js via NVM". Installs the current LTS versions, sets the newest as default, moves global packages over, and removes non-LTS versions.
Command-line mode with a dry run, and a test script for automated checks.
Rewritten to reinstall global packages, restore the previous default version, and avoid the npm ".DS_Store" error.
Installs the newest release of each Node.js major version already installed.
First version. Updates npm and nvm using your shell profile.
